card.name: Linking words before combination-therapy drugs
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, with, after, either, a) right before a named partner drug in oncology label text, especially in 'in combination with' phrases and 'prior to' cisplatin.

modes.label: In combination with
modes.description: The word 'with' or 'Either' ends the phrase 'in combination with' just before the partner chemotherapy drugs.
modes.example: the FLAURA2 study, cardiomyopathy occurred in 9% of the 276 patients who received TAGRISSO in combination<< with>> pemetrexed and platinum-based chemotherapy

modes.label: Sequencing words before a drug
modes.description: 'to' or 'after' sits between an anticancer drug and the next therapy named in a sequence.
modes.example: units every 3 weeks or 790 mg/9,600 units every 6 weeks Administer KEYTRUDA QLEX prior<< to>> cisplatin when given on the same

modes.label: Start of dexamethasone
modes.description: The first letter of dexamethasone after 'and' or 'of' in myeloma regimens.
